snippet.title: Is this a Game yet? | What will YOU Design - Early Access Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Is this a Game yet? on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3831220/Is_this_a_Game_yet/ and join this once in a lifetime game design and development experience on day 1.

Is This a Game Yet? is launching into Early Access on Steam on July 10th at 7:00 PM CEST!

I made a Game that's EMPTY inside so YOU Can Design It Yourself.

As a solo developer, I'm building this game live on stream, and YOU get to be a part of the development process every single week. Submit your wildest game design ideas, and the top 3 high scores and top 2 most-liked submissions on the leaderboard will be implemented in the game for the next week's update.

We've been testing this concept in the free open beta here https://littleneedleinteractive.itch.io/is-this-a-game-yet and now it's time for the full Early Access launch! The open beta is still running until the steam release and its third update cycle starts tomorrow (July 3rd, 7:00 PM CEST)
